text: Professional Positioning and Training ObjectivesJournalism is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the laws of news dissemination, information production and social impact. It integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as communication studies, sociology, literature and law, aiming to cultivate compound media talents with the ability of news reporting, writing, editing and evaluation, all-media operation thinking and social responsibility.Core training objectives:Master news theory, communication laws and media ethics, and possess the ability to independently plan, interview, write and edit.Familiar with the content production processes of multiple platforms such as newspapers, television, and new media, and capable of using digital tools to complete news creation;Cultivate critical thinking and social insight, and be capable of engaging in information dissemination and public opinion guidance work in media, government, enterprises and other institutions.
